translation.name: Seongsu Beauty & Fashion Route
translation.summary: A half-day Seongsu route focused on K-beauty, footwear, fashion retail and the neighborhood's trend-driven shopping streets.
translation.description: This route is for travelers interested in contemporary Korean beauty and fashion. It connects an experiential beauty space with footwear-focused stores and Seongsu's main shopping streets.

stops.note: Start with a K-beauty experience in a renovated Seongsu space.
Browse contemporary Korean footwear near Seongsu Station.
Compare modern Korean footwear design with Seongsu's traditional shoe-making identity.
Finish by exploring boutiques, concept stores and current pop-ups around Yeonmujang-gil.
